name: The Etherium

reach.title: The well
text:
Books disappear.
I read them. I put them down.
They are gone.

I never cared.
There are so many.

Today, I watched.
They slide to the well.
They fall without a sound.

In the middle, a book floats.
It does not fall.
A strange liquid runs over it.
Drop by drop.
Is it everything I have read?

I lean over.
I reach out.
It is almost mine.
reach.warning: Everything you hold will be lost: pages, methods, Knowledge, intuitions. +{n} Ether.

wake.title: The void
text:
My fingers close on the book.
I am holding it.

Below me, the void.
It calls me.
As if the answer I seek
slept at the very bottom.
I let go.

I wake up.
A hexagon.
It is not mine.

In my hand, the book.
It is still wet.

gone.title: Nothing
text: I was sure I was holding it.

next: Next Ether: {n} pages read in all

start.name: Head start
start.description: When I wake, I already know how to skim.

memory.name: Memory of methods
memory.description: These sentences, the well no longer erases.
